crossRefs.note: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you…

parallels.note: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,
translations.bsb: Moses also told the whole congregation of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded:
translations.kjv: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
translations.asv: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which Jehovah commanded, saying,
